Reference PR: https://github.com/google/guice/pull/1551

## Your Task

The source code is in `/guice`. Fix all compilation errors so that `mvn compile` succeeds.

**Summary of the fix:**

In `/guice/extensions/struts2/test/com/google/inject/struts2/Struts2FactoryTest.java`, changed the import:
- **Before:** `import org.apache.struts2.dispatcher.ng.filter.StrutsPrepareAndExecuteFilter;`
- **After:** `import org.apache.struts2.dispatcher.filter.StrutsPrepareAndExecuteFilter;`

This is a known breaking change in Struts 2.5.x where the `ng` (next generation) subpackage was removed as the filter became the standard implementation.
